Structural Organization.
The Administration
shall consist of the Governing Board, the Office of the
Administrator, the
Offices of such
Administrators as may be necessary; Office of the Director for
each of the principal subdivisions of its internal structure.
The Governing Board shall be composed of the Secretary
of Labor and Employment as Chairman, the Administrator
and a third member,. considered well-versed in the
field of overseas employment who shall be appointed by
the President to serve for a term of two (2) years;
b) The Administrator and such Deputy Administrator and
Directors as may be necessary shall be appointed by
the President upon recommendation of the Secretary;
The functional structure of the Administration shall
be established along the areas of: market development,
employment, welfare, licensing, regulation and
adjudication.
Each of the principal substantive
subdivisions of the Administration shall be headed by
a Director and shall have such departments and units
as may be necessary.
Regional Extension Units.
The Administration
is hereby authorized to set up regional extension units in such
regions as the Governing Board may determine to be necessary to
promote efficient and economic delivery of its services.
